text:
matt: odd surge in evictions in ap-south1 this morning, looks like many tiny pods pinned to a handful of nodes.
olivia: saw that too. label-syncer rollout yesterday added `node.k8s.io/zone-prefer=highlocal` which seems to combine badly with our anti-affinity.
raj: right — scheduler ends up preserving anti-affinity seats on nodes that no longer have free slots, so small pods pile onto older racks = shelf islands.
ops-bot: Alert: ap-south1_pod_eviction_rate 0.85% (rolling 20m)
matt: telemetry shows a mismatch: autoscaler removed 4 nodes but label-syncer didn't update node metadata before scheduler decisions. Latebind + anti-affinity = fragmentation.
olivia: mitigation idea: enable a graceful-label-fallback that treats missing zone-prefer as "neutral" for 30m. Scope only to pods with annotation `infra/binpack=opt-in`.
raj: Also reduce preempt window from 60s -> 20s to allow faster rescheduling of tiny-gang members. Downside: more preempt churn.
matt: command to patch configmap: ```kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n infra --type merge --patch '{"data":{"graceful_label_fallback":"true","fallback_ttl":"30m","preempt_window":"20s"}}'```
ops-bot: Runbook check OK: CI green required + oncall approval.
olivia: CI is green. Oncall acked. Starting canary in ap-south1a.
ops-bot: Canary deployed by olivia at 1825000015. Monitoring eviction-rate and pack efficiency.
matt: 9m update: eviction-rate dropped 0.85% -> 0.25%, pack efficiency improved ~6%. No NVLINK-sensitive jobs affected.
raj: good signal. follow-up: add gating in label-rollout to wait for node-metadata-sync metric >= 99% before enabling zone-prefer. Create ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket SCHED-5100 created by raj
